overrides: Applied immediately after normal loading and before settling. Only measured-side two tilt joints friction0, OR only measured-side click qf0, OR only measured-side click qf-.111N. Preserve all other joints/qf and normal drive policies. Baseline and old model have no overrides.
old_preload_basis: Old k18500 *(.015*.0004)=.111N. Diagnostic new low spring remains1000 when qf-.111; old model remains entirely original, not a single-field contrast.
observations: All joint policies and qf before/after; every step from initial settle to release: named q/qvel, actual total tilt, incoming child-joint-frame wrench for both tilt joints. Net transmitted force is not the isolated friction solver bound or drive/limit force.
interpretation: If zero tilt friction restores loading and removing/lowering preload also restores it, evidence supports a friction-preload interaction; one-factor contributions do not alone prove the precise internal load path. If only friction helps and preload changes do not, do not claim preload-driven friction. Main-model results are a multi-model control. No production policy changes.
stop: Finish preregistered batch, report cause and remaining uncertainty/options; no T3v2/T4, no numerical search or automatic production fix.
